newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea buys 8,443 tonnes of frozen beef - traders.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea buys 8,443 tonnes of frozen beef - traders.

text.p: South Korea's state-run Livestock Products Marketing Organization (LPMO) on Tuesday bought a total of 8,443 tonnes of frozen beef through tenders, traders said on Wednesday.
They said the organisation bought 2,571 tonnes of U.S., 342 tonnes of Canadian, 3,840 tonnes of Australian and 1,690 tonnes of New Zealand beef.
U.S. and Canadian chuck roll was bought at between $2,425 and $2,624 per tonne on a cost and freight basis, traders said.
Australian grass-fed fullset was bought at $2,450-$2,659 a tonne and Australian and New Zealand grass-fed bone-in beef at $1,638-$1,771, they said.
Arrivals were set for Seoul (5,080 tonnes), Pusan (2,119 tonnes), Taegu (300 tonnes) and Naju (944 tonnes).
Shipment of 4,226 tonnes was slated for June 20 and that for 4,217 tonnes for June 30.
